question: In October 2019, who among the following cricketers became the first Indian cricketer to play 100 Twenty20 International matches?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harmanpreet Kaur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cricketer**: Harmanpreet Kaur.
 
• **Achievement**: Became the first Indian cricketer to play **100** Twenty20 International matches.
 
• **Date**: Achieved this milestone in **October 2019**.
 
• **Role**: Kaur is an all-rounder and captain of the India women's national team in all formats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Harmanpreet Kaur, a prominent figure in Indian women's cricket, has received several awards and accolades for her contributions to the sport. 
 
 
• Kaur received the **Arjuna Award** from the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, recognizing her outstanding performance in national sports. This award is given to athletes who have shown excellence in their respective fields and contributed to the promotion of sports in India.
 
• **Outstanding Woman Cricketer of the Year (2017)**
 
• Kaur was named the **ICC Women's T20I Cricketer of the Year** for her exceptional performance in 2018 and 2019. She scored over 500 runs in T20Is during this period, showcasing her skills and consistency.
 
• In 2020, she was honored with the **Maharashtra Gaurav Puraskar**, recognizing her achievements in sports and her contribution to elevating women's cricket in Maharashtra.
 
• Kaur was awarded the **Padma Shri**, India's fourth highest civilian award, in 2020 for her exceptional contribution to sports, marking a significant milestone in her career.
 
• **Leading Run-scorer in ICC Women's World Cup (2017)**
